problem:
A wastewater holding basin initially holds $450\,\text{L}$ of water containing $9\,\text{kg}$ of dissolved contaminants.
Clean water is pumped into the basin at a rate of $20\,\text{L/min},$ while the completely mixed liquid leaves the basin at a rate of $25\,\text{L/min}.$
Find, rounded to two decimal places, the amount of contaminants in the basin $12$ minutes after the clean water pumping begins.
